attr.title: Residual
attr.desc: Explore alien planets, gather resources and repair your ship in this procedurally generated survival platformer by Orangepixel.
attr.inst: Install Residual.zip with PortMaster, then copy residual.jar from your GOG Windows 1.4.1 installation into the installed residual folder. On muOS use <SD card>/ports/residual/residual.jar. See the README for the supported checksum and offline-installer instructions. Requires 64-bit ARM firmware; PortMaster provides Java 17 and Westonpack.
